desc: Henry is proud to introduce the latest innovation from their Special Products Division - the H23 SPD PREDATOR .223 Rem/5.56 NATO - the most accurate lever action ever built and the only one backed by a three-shot sub-MOA guarantee. Optimized for predator and varmint hunting, the "Precision Rifle Engineered for Dispatching Agile Targets Over Range" (PREDATOR) is built on the same platform as the Lever Action Supreme Rifle.
